acceptance_rule: Accept only if focused tests prove alpha_search, alpha_discovery, and universe_scout cannot reserve or claim without a hash-bound promotion request whose finalized candidate passed D0-D3 and whose launcher-attested challenger and verifier use the opposite runtime family from the initiator; same-runtime, missing, tampered, unresolved, and panel-mismatch cases fail closed; measurement_repair remains unaffected; no trading behavior changes.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Alpha discovery can bypass independent challenge because mailbox identities are self-declared and experiment reservation or claim does not require a D0-D3 panel-bound opposite-runtime debate. Binding launcher-attested Codex-versus-Claude debate evidence and a verified promotion request into alpha ticket creation and claim should prevent same-model self-review and direct-ticket bypasses without changing trading logic.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: Reopen only with materially more closed Space catalyst rows (at least +50% and +10 de-duplicated direct-official rows), a PIT historical Space event archive that creates canonical window coverage, or an ex-event same-theme replacement basket that changes opportunity-cost measurement.
A valid alpha retry needs genuinely new closed rows, a new PIT data source, a new gate shape, or a shared helper with full historical and daily default-off coverage.

['closed forward replacement-value rows before live activation', 'separate Gate 1-4 trade adapter before any live/default orders', 'no nearby prior-window/source-set/notional retunes on frozen windows']

A valid next alpha needs a non-saturated PIT field such as borrow fee/utilization, loan availability, historical options with as-of controls, materially more closed forward replacement rows, or a true historical Moomoo capital-flow archive.

['do not retry nearby liquidity/range thresholds on this frozen consensus sample', 'clean current-code baseline parity versus docs/backtesting.md before any positive retention', 'forward closed replacement-value rows before activation', 'materially new cost field such as spread/borrow/availability if revisiting this lane']

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.
